note: An obvious worktree conflict should route to merge/rebase or a halt, yet this step runs the verify gate. The gate checks finished artifacts, so it cannot resolve the overlap that invoked it. / Card worktrees are isolated copies, so a conflict cannot arise inside one; it only appears when worktrees merge. This clashes with "each changed card in its own worktree." / Verifying while card worktrees still conflict contradicts the purpose of the verify gate. The condition should stop implementation and route to resolution, not proceed to verification.
